title: PPT Master deck authored here, built and opened on the machine
note: The default test task of this repo (docx/pptx + a native pptx deck). The task itself is NOT part of the runner: copy this file, change the steps, and the same loop drives a different repo's task. Which deck (generator/project/output) comes from code/pptmaster_deck.json.

steps.why: author the deck's pages from THIS repo's numbers - fast, no install, catches layout bugs before a round is spent
the repo's own gate list (code/gates.json) - the same questions check_all.sh asks

windows.why: the same job on Windows: code/pptmaster_local.ps1 resolves a REAL powershell.exe, finds a python 3.10+ (registry/PATH/conda/hardware report), clones + venvs ppt-master, builds the deck and then code/local_check.ps1 4c opens it in the real PowerPoint

linux.why: the whole local plane on Linux/macOS in one step: code/pptmaster_local.sh finds a python 3.10+, clones ppt-master if it is missing, builds the venv + core deps, runs the pipeline (pages authored here -> svg_quality_checker -> svg_to_pptx -> structural re-check -> pptx_delivery_check) and proves a real application can open the file with LibreOffice headless; the receipt it writes is what this runner then asserts

sandbox_vs_local.why_local: the deck must be produced by the machine's own installed venv and opened by the machine's own Office - a sandbox build proves the pages compile, not that the toolchain works there
